senses.gloss: f. pl.(b. h. מהמרות; המר, cmp. חָמַר, חֲמַר I)debris, mounds used as burying places for executed criminals.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:5:3">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בראשונה … במ׳</he> in former days they buried them (the convicts) in mounds (while later on special places were provided for them; v.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:5">Snh. VI, 5</cite>); Y. Snh. VI, 23ᵈ bot. <he>במח׳</he> (correct the entire passage in accordance with Y. M. Kat. l. c.).
